caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a decorative shield-shaped back that features an intricate, symmetrical lattice design in the center. The chair has curved armrests that connect to the seat and the backrest. The legs are straight and slightly tapered. The cushioned seat is upholstered with light blue and green vertical stripes, accented with small, rounded brass or bronze studs along the bottom edge. The entire chair, including the back, arms, and legs, is colored in a reddish-brown wood tone. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, enclosed within a faint rectangular border, with no additional objects or details present. The artist's signature is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Armchair
